content.comment_body: Hello, Apologies for these basic questions, but I couldn't find an answer: Is the [product_name] 24CE compatible with all [product_name] expansion modules such as the DM16 24R? Or is the [product_name] 24RCE compatible with the DM16 24? Can we use all analog expansion modules with any [product_name] basic module? If not, where can I find the hardware requirements for each expansion module? Thank you very much for your assistance. [user_name]

Expansion modules of the [article_no] series can be used with each [product_name] base module and with one another. Exception 1: Digital 24 VDC expansion modules cannot be directly combined with 230 VAC base or expansion modules. An analog expansion module is required in between to ensure electrical isolation. Exception 2: 230 VAC expansion modules must not be added to digital 24 VDC expansion or analog expansion modules.
Thanks for highlighting that in the manual.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for clarity regarding the compatibility between specific [product_name] base and expansion modules, especially concerning voltage levels and module types. There is confusion caused by the mix of 24 VDC and 230 VAC modules, and users need safe combination guidelines. Manual documentation has proven valuable, though initially, information on compatibility is harder to locate.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear and accessible instructions about which [product_name] expansion modules can be paired with different [product_name] base modules, paying particular attention to voltage compatibility and module type, to enable safe and reliable system design.
